StreamTerrainInfluenceAtAnchorDescriptio:
Stream's terrain influence strength at the scaling anchor length.
Most stream properties fade in with terrain influence, so you can almost treat it as the stream opacity for most features.
StreamTerrainInfluenceAtSourceDescriptio:
Stream's terrain influence strength at the source.
Most stream properties fade in with terrain influence, so you can almost treat it as the stream opacity for most features.
StreamWidthInterpolationPowerDescription:
Power curve for interpolating noise related features from source to mouth.
Currently applies to height variation and canyon wall rockiness, may be used for more later.

MoundSuppression.EnabledDescription:
Enables suppression of terrain mounds/hills within stream areas.
This is an asymmetrical noise reduction specifically set up to target small mounds that get in the way of rivers.
The terrain sampling on the watershed model helps to avoid most rough terrain and bumps, but rarely some get through so this is used to carve through them.
It carves canyons into the terrain a little bit, but its worth it to prevent streams from being split apart by a mound.
MoundSuppression.StrengthDescription: Strength of mound suppression in stream areas.

MoundSuppressionDescription: Configuration for suppressing terrain mounds/hills within stream areas.

LandformCarving.EnabledDescription:
Enables carving of landform features (hills/mounds) in stream areas.
This is the older landform component of the mound suppression.
While the more general asymmetric noise suppression does a better job of carving down mounds, it seems landform noise still gets in the way a little bit.
Haven't touched this much since I got the asymmetric noise suppression working, it needs another look at some point.
LandformCarving.StrengthDescription: Strength of landform carving in stream areas.
LandformCarving.PowerDescription: Power curve for landform carving scaling.
LandformCarving.UseExponentialDescription: Use exponential scaling for landform carving instead of linear.

LandformCarvingDescription: Configuration for carving down landform hills/mounds in stream areas.

StreambankHeightVariation.EnabledDescription: Enables natural height variation along streambanks via adding extra noise.
StreambankHeightVariation.FactorsAtSourceDescription: Per-octave streambank height variation factors at stream sources.
StreambankHeightVariation.FactorsAtMouthDescription: Per-octave streambank height variation factors at stream mouths.
StreambankHeightVariation.MaxVariationDescription: Maximum streambank height variation for each octave.

StreambankHeightVariationDescription: Configuration for natural height variation along streambanks via adding extra noise.

CanyonRockiness.EnabledDescription: Enables rocky/cliffy variation on canyon walls via adding extra noise.
CanyonRockiness.FactorsAtSourceDescription: Per-octave canyon wall rockiness factors at stream sources.
CanyonRockiness.FactorsAtMouthDescription: Per-octave canyon wall rockiness factors at stream mouths.
CanyonRockiness.MaxRockinessDescription: Maximum canyon wall rockiness for each octave.

CanyonRockinessDescription: Configuration for rocky/cliffy variation on canyon walls via adding extra noise.

StreambedSmoothing.EnabledDescription: Enables smoothing of streambed height transitions.
StreambedSmoothing.LookaheadDistanceDescription: Distance (in curve points) to look ahead when smoothing streambed heights.
StreambedSmoothing.SlopeDepthScalingDescription:
Multiplier that scales how much terrain slope affects streambed depth.
Higher values carve deeper streambeds where the terrain drops.

StreambedSmoothingDescription:
Configuration for smoothing streambed height transitions.
Creates a smooth streambed.

SeaLevelFade.SeaLevelFadeStartOffsetDescription:
Blocks below sea level where stream displacement fade begins.
Fades out the displacement (stream terrain carving/erosion) as it gets closer to the stream mouth.
SeaLevelFade.SeaLevelFadeEndOffsetDescription:
Blocks below sea level where stream displacement fade ends.
Fades out the displacement (stream terrain carving/erosion) as it gets closer to the stream mouth.

SeaLevelFadeDescription:
Configuration for fading out stream displacement (terrain carving/erosion) near sea level.
This helps to prevent deep stream carving near shallow drains.
Its alright at the current settings, but if you make it more aggressive and shallow it starts looking pretty rough.
